sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: seat belts, child restraints and unattended children and pets
Knowledge facts: part C holds 21 fact blocks (sec03-F01 onward) from physical pages 25 to 26; part C2 holds 8 confusable and continuation blocks (sec03-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A names the issuer (physical page 3), the DMV 700 March 2024 edition (physical page 1) and the test format from the Testing page (physical page 12); question count, passing standard and time limit are not printed and stay unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NV-BELT-A-COUNT — knowledge-test question count not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-BELT-A-PASS — passing score or percentage not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-BELT-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-BELT-A-FRESH — confirm the March 2024 edition is still current (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NV-BELT-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NV-BELT-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the fatality statistics (sec03-F02, sec03-F03) describe a fixed reporting period and will change in later editions; all other facts are stable statutory rules as printed.

corpus_stability.reason: The Nevada Driver's Handbook carries one edition line on its cover (DMV 700 March 2024) and one copyright year on its title page, with a short key-changes list; nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year. The edition is about two and a half years old at intake, so currency is held as freshness debt in part A.
